description: List the businesses in the Flathead Trades directory for a kind of work, optionally in one town, with phone numbers, websites and a link to each listing. Covers Whitefish, Columbia Falls, Evergreen, Kalispell, Somers, Bigfork, Lakeside and Polson, Montana.

town.description: Optional town in the Flathead Valley, e.g. "Kalispell" or "Whitefish".

trade.description: The kind of work, e.g. "roofing", "plumber", "electrician", "builder", "septic", "tree removal".

name: find_pros
